```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(sf)
library(ggspatial)
library(units)
```

```{r load-data}
source(here("R", "00-config.R"))

# load(here("output", "figs", "figure_inputs.rda"))
cluster_dat <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "cluster_dat.rds"))
districts_tib <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "districts_tib.rds"))
amhara_shp <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "amhara_shp.rds"))

eth1_shp <- st_read(here("data", "eth_admin_boundaries", "eth_admin1.shp"))

morans_raw <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "morans_i_results.rds"))
spatial_preds <- readRDS(here("data", "clean", "spatial_preds.rds"))
```

n_text <- cluster_dat %>%
  group_by(district, district_n, marker) %>%
  summarise(total_indiv = sum(n),
            total_clusters = n_distinct(cluster_id),
            n_zero = sum(pos==0),
            mean_prev = mean(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_prev = sd(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
            med_prev = median(prev, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0("n indiv = ", total_indiv, "\nzero prev clusters = ", n_zero,
                      "/", total_clusters, "\nMean (SD) prev = ", round(mean_prev, 1), 
                      " (", round(sd_prev, 1), ") %"),
         txt2 = paste0("N = ", total_indiv))

```{r fig2 setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

pad_frac_bottom <- 0.2

# Precompute district meta (geometry + padded limits)

district_meta <- districts_tib %>%
  mutate(
    boundary = map(district_shp, ~ amhara_shp %>%
                     filter(adm3_name == .x) %>%
                     dplyr::select(geometry) %>%
                     sf::st_transform(4326)),
    bb = map(boundary, sf::st_bbox),
    xlim = map(bb, ~ c(.x[["xmin"]], .x[["xmax"]])),
    ylim = map(bb, ~ c(.x[["ymin"]], .x[["ymax"]])),
    ylim_padded = map(ylim, ~ {
      yrng <- diff(.x)
      c(.x[1] - pad_frac_bottom * yrng, .x[2])
    })
  )

morans_results <- morans_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(k == 5, marker == "Pgp3") %>%
  dplyr::select(district, morans_I, p_value)

district_meta <- district_meta %>%
  left_join(morans_results, by = join_by(district)) %>%
  mutate(moran_txt = paste0("I = ", round(morans_I, 2), "\n",
                             "p = ", signif(p_value, 2), "\n\n")) %>%
  mutate(x = case_when(
    district %in% c("Metema", "Machakel", "Debay Tilatgin", 
                    "Fogera", "Tach Gaynt", "Bibugn") ~ - Inf,
    district %in% c("Ebinat", "Fagita Lekoma", 
                    "Goncha", "Albuko",
                    "Debre Birhan Town", "Woreta Town") ~ Inf,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_),
  y = case_when(
    district %in% c("Metema", "Ebinat", "Fagita Lekoma", 
                    "Goncha", "Debay Tilatgin", 
                    "Debre Birhan Town", "Tach Gaynt", 
                    "Fogera", "Albuko", "Woreta Town") ~ -Inf,
    district %in% c("Machakel", "Bibugn") ~ Inf,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_),
  hjust = case_when(
    x == Inf & y == -Inf ~ 1,
    x == Inf & y == Inf ~ 1,
    x == -Inf & y == -Inf ~ 0,
    x == -Inf & y == Inf ~ 0
  ),
  vjust = case_when(
    x == Inf & y == -Inf ~ 0,
    x == Inf & y == Inf ~ 1,
    x == -Inf & y == -Inf ~ 0,
    x == -Inf & y == Inf ~ 1
  ))
  

# Handy lookup lists 
boundary_by_dist <- set_names(district_meta$boundary, district_meta$district)
xlim_by_dist     <- set_names(district_meta$xlim,     district_meta$district)
ylim_by_dist     <- set_names(district_meta$ylim_padded, district_meta$district)

# Pre-split points by district
pgp3_points_by_dist <- cluster_dat %>%
  filter(marker == "Pgp3") %>%
  mutate(district = as.character(district)) %>%
  transmute(district, lon, lat, prev_perc) %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ unique(.x$district)))

pgp3_pts_sf <- cluster_dat %>%
  filter(marker == "Pgp3") %>%
  transmute(lon, lat, prev_perc) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

get_points_in_boundary <- function(boundary_sf) {
  # boundary_sf is an sf with 1 polygon/multipolygon row
  inside <- sf::st_within(pgp3_pts_sf, boundary_sf, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]
  pgp3_pts_sf[inside, , drop = FALSE]
}


# helper so missing districts return empty df (but still plot boundary + padding)
get_points <- function(dist) {
  pgp3_points_by_dist[[dist]] %||% tibble(lon = numeric(), lat = numeric(), prev = numeric())
}

# Pre-split predictions by district
pgp3_preds_by_dist <- spatial_preds %>%
  dplyr::select(district, marker, predictions) %>%
  filter(marker == "Pgp3") %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(predictions, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(
    predictions = map(predictions, ~ dplyr::select(.x, -any_of(c("district", "marker"))))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(predictions, keep_empty = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(value = pmin(pmax(value, 0), 1) * 100) %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ as.character(unique(.x$district))[1]))


get_preds <- function(dist) {
  idx <- match(dist, names(pgp3_preds_by_dist))
  if (!is.na(idx)) pgp3_preds_by_dist[[idx]] else tibble(x=numeric(), y=numeric(), value=numeric())
}
```

```{r fig2-plot}
# Shared theme + coord helper
base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = 2)),
    plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3),

    legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    legend.ticks = element_blank()
  )

coord_for_dist <- function(dist) {
  coord_sf(
    crs = 4326,
    xlim = xlim_by_dist[[dist]],
    ylim = ylim_by_dist[[dist]],
    expand = FALSE,
    clip = "on"
  )
}

scale_bar <- ggspatial::annotation_scale(
  style = "bar",
  location = "br",
  width_hint = 0.2,
  pad_y = unit(0.02, "npc"),
  pad_x = unit(0.02, "npc")
)

# Plot maker functions

make_prev_plot <- function(dist) {
  boundary <- boundary_by_dist[[dist]]
  pts <- get_points_in_boundary(boundary)

  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(
      data = pts,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, size = prev_perc, fill = prev_perc),
      pch = 21, alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = district_meta %>% filter(district == !!dist),
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = moran_txt, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
      size = 2.5, lineheight = 0.9
    ) +
    coord_for_dist(dist) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="D", direction=1, limits=c(0,100), breaks=seq(0,100,25),
                         name="Prevalence (%)",
                         guide=guide_colorbar(direction="horizontal", label.position="bottom",
                                              ticks=FALSE, barheight=unit(8,"pt"), barwidth=unit(100,"pt"))) +
    scale_size_continuous(limits=c(0,100), range=c(0.5,6), name="Prevalence (%)",
                          guide=guide_legend(direction="horizontal", label.position="bottom",
                                             title.position="top", keywidth=unit(15,"pt"),
                                             keyheight=unit(8,"pt"),
                                             override.aes=list(fill="grey50", alpha=0.6, pch=21))) +
    base_theme +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    scale_bar +
    guides(fill="none", size="none")
}

make_pred_plot <- function(dist, show_legend = FALSE) {
  boundary <- boundary_by_dist[[dist]]
  pts <- get_points_in_boundary(boundary) %>% transmute(lon, lat)
  preds <- get_preds(dist)

  raster_or_fill <- if (nrow(preds) > 0) {
    list(
      geom_raster(data = preds, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value), interpolate = FALSE),
      geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
    )
  } else {
    list(
      geom_sf(data = boundary, fill = "grey75", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot() +
    raster_or_fill +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(x = lon, y = lat),
               pch = 20, size = 0.5, color = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
    coord_for_dist(dist) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="D", direction=1, limits=c(0,100), breaks=seq(0,100,25),
                         name="Prevalence (%)",
                         guide=guide_colorbar(direction="horizontal", label.position="bottom",
                                              ticks=FALSE, barheight=unit(8,"pt"), barwidth=unit(100,"pt"))) +
    base_theme +
    scale_bar

  if (!show_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p
}

# Build paired panels 
spacer <- plot_spacer() + theme_minimal()

district_pairs <- imap(districts_tib$district, function(dist, i) {

  p_prev <- make_prev_plot(dist)
  p_pred <- make_pred_plot(dist, show_legend = FALSE)

  pair <- plot_grid(
    p_prev, p_pred,
    nrow = 1,
    align = "hv",
    axis = "tblr",
    rel_widths = c(1, 1)
  )

  title <- ggdraw() +
    draw_label(dist, fontface = "plain", size = 10, hjust = 0.5)

  plot_grid(
    title,
    pair,
    spacer,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.12, 1, 0.02)
  )
})

# Legend from first district plot 
legend_plot <- make_pred_plot(districts_tib$district[[1]], show_legend = TRUE) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

legend <- get_legend(legend_plot)

legend_row <- plot_grid(
  spacer, legend, spacer,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(0.2, 1, 0.2)
)
```

```{r fig2-assemble}
# Arrange into rows (2 districts per row, with gap column)
rows <- map(
  split(district_pairs, ceiling(seq_along(district_pairs) / 3)),
  ~ plot_grid(
      .x[[1]],
      spacer,
      .x[[2]],
      spacer,
      .x[[3]],
      nrow = 1,
      rel_widths = c(1, 0.10, 1, 0.10, 1),
      align = "hv"
    )
)

fig2_panels <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = rows,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "hv"
)

fig2 <- plot_grid(
  fig2_panels,
  legend_row,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.1)
)

fig2
```
